content.short: Koywe provides real-time global treasury and international payments infrastructure in Latin America.
content.description: Koywe offers Latin American businesses round-the-clock international payments and treasury management, with transparent rates in place of the opaque spreads typical of regional banking. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. Treasury management is where stablecoin rails compete most directly with incumbent banking, since the comparison is measured in settlement days.
